summary:
Round 2 (read-only). The delta 2db189ec7..cab5f4a56 mostly merges current main (#498 and its history, 5aed5435). The #500-specific source change is commit e53abe27 (5 files, +105/-37): .github/workflows/inspect-demo-storage.yml, scripts/maintenance/demo-storage-binding-readonly.mjs, scripts/maintenance/demo-storage-inspect.mjs and the two test files. cab5f4a5 adds evidence only.

Round-1 findings:
1. HIGH — unverified `npm install -g @railway/cli@5.66.0` and a PATH-resolved binary run with RAILWAY_DEMO_TOKEN (inspect-demo-storage.yml:65): RESOLVED. The credential-free install step now downloads the fixed release asset https://github.com/railwayapp/cli/releases/download/v5.66.0/railway-v5.66.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz with curl --fail, checks SHA-256 5b3f4e77ddf986161fb760842d718b23ab587a59f9badf610c1fb7b80bcbcb3e with sha256sum --check before extracting, extracts only `railway`, and requires `railway 5.66.0` from --version. The binary path is derived by verifiedRailwayPath(RUNNER_TEMP) (strict absolute, normalized path; no '.', '..' or trailing slash). The same function is enforced at runtime: validateContext pins cliPath, createReadOnlyAccess re-checks it, and spawn uses context.cliPath instead of `railway` from PATH. I verified this independently against the primary source, read-only through the GitHub API: railwayapp/cli release v5.66.0 (published 2026-10-12) reports digest sha256:5b3f4e77ddf986161fb760842d718b23ab587a59f9badf610c1fb7b80bcbcb3e for that exact asset, identical to the pin.
2. MEDIUM — account-bearer variables reads not scoped to the demo project and environment (demo-storage-inspect.mjs:278): RESOLVED. In account-bearer mode, every allowed variables command (BACKEND_IDENTITY, BACKEND_CONFIG, DATABASE_CONFIG, RUNTIME_CONFIG) must be exactly `variables --service <id> --project <TARGET.projectId> --environment <TARGET.environmentId> --json`. The project-token mode keeps the previously approved argv. The unchanged pure binding module still issues its original argv. A private bindingCall adapter accepts only the exact original argv for the current step's expected service, rewrites it to the scoped form, and routes it through the same allowlisted call(). The public call() never accepts an unscoped account read. Tests cover the scoped argv for both modes and the rejection of unscoped account reads.
3. LOW — unused SAFE_REPLACEMENT_ERRORS set with redeploy/replacement codes in the read-only module, and a header typo: RESOLVED. The set is removed and the comment fixed. The module remains pure, importing only node:path and node:crypto.

Unchanged and still holding from round 1: manual dispatch only on main with the reviewed SHA and actor guards; the PR trigger runs tests only, without secrets; contents: read; SHA-pinned actions; persist-credentials false; tests in a separate credential-free job; own concurrency group demo-storage-inspect (not railway-backend); a receipt-only artifact (IDs, counts, flags, constant codes); RAILWAY_DEMO_TOKEN environment-scoped behind the main-only demo environment; read-only command and query allowlist; double binding reads, classifier and no-cleanup receipt identical in behaviour to the version approved on issue #470 (92931e60).

CI on cab5f4a56: test, gate, secret-scan, frontend-tests, browser-e2e, archive-tests, bug-pipeline-tests, real-provider, windows-review-setup and Vercel all pass. inspect, configure-repository and verify-provider-access are skipped by design (dispatch-only).

Limit: the evidence is synthetic (fake CLI and providers). No real Railway inspection has run yet; the first real dispatch will show whether CLI 5.66.0 accepts `variables --project --environment` with an account token. The workflow fails closed with constant codes if it does not.

Read with git (blobless clone) and the GitHub API; no PR code or tests were run by the reviewer.
